name: Dawn Patrol Tee
short_description: A featherweight merino-blend tee that breathes on the climb and dries before the summit.
description:
Cut long so it stays tucked under a pack, with flatlock seams moved away from strap lines. The merino blend resists odour, so one tee covers a multi-day trip.

• Merino / Tencel blend, 140 gsm
• Flatlock seams, strap-friendly shoulders
• Naturally odour resistant
• Weight: 132 g (size M)
• Machine wash cold, hang dry

name: Dawn Patrol Tee — Forest Stripe
short_description: The Dawn Patrol Tee in a forest stripe, same featherweight merino blend.
description:
Same cut and fabric as the plain Dawn Patrol Tee, with a yarn-dyed forest stripe that will not crack or fade.

• Merino / Tencel blend, 140 gsm
• Yarn-dyed stripe, not printed
• Flatlock seams, strap-friendly shoulders
• Weight: 134 g (size M)

name: Ridge 5" Shorts
short_description: Quick-drying trail shorts with a bonded liner and deep drop-in pockets.
description:
A 5-inch inseam that clears the knee on steep descents, a bonded liner that does not chafe, and two drop-in pockets that hold a phone without bouncing.

• Recycled ripstop shell, DWR finish
• Bonded inner brief
• Two drop-in pockets, one zipped rear
• Inseam: 5 in / 12.7 cm
• Weight: 118 g (size M)

name: Ridge 7" Shorts
short_description: The Ridge short with a 7-inch inseam for longer days and cooler legs.
description:
Two extra inches of coverage over the 5-inch Ridge, with the same bonded liner, drop-in pockets and quick-drying ripstop.

• Recycled ripstop shell, DWR finish
• Bonded inner brief
• Two drop-in pockets, one zipped rear
• Inseam: 7 in / 17.8 cm
• Weight: 132 g (size M)

name: Storm Cell Jacket
short_description: A 2.5-layer shell that packs into its own chest pocket.
description:
Fully taped seams, a helmet-compatible hood and a chest pocket that swallows the whole jacket. Built for sustained rain on exposed ridges, not just a shower.

• 2.5-layer waterproof shell, 20k/20k
• Fully taped seams
• Adjustable hood with wired peak
• Packs into its own chest pocket
• Weight: 268 g (size M)

name: Storm Cell Pants
short_description: Waterproof overtrousers with full-length side zips.
description:
Pull them on over shoes without stopping: full-length zips down both legs, taped seams and a drawcord waist that sits under a pack belt.

• 2.5-layer waterproof shell, 20k/20k
• Full-length side zips with storm flaps
• Fully taped seams
• Drawcord waist
• Weight: 312 g (size M)

name: Dawn Windshell Jacket
short_description: A packable windshell for cold starts and exposed ridgelines.
description:
Cuts the wind without holding sweat, packs to the size of a fist and lives in the bottom of a vest for the day the weather turns.

• Wind-resistant ripstop, DWR finish
• Packs into its own pocket
• Half-zip with chin guard
• Reflective logo at the rear
• Weight: 118 g (size M)

name: Long Haul Tights
short_description: Compression tights with a drawcord waist and two thigh pockets.
description:
Graduated compression that holds up over long days, a flat drawcord waist that stays put, and two thigh pockets for gels and a key.

• Nylon / elastane, 240 gsm
• Graduated compression
• Flat drawcord waist
• Two thigh pockets, one zipped
• Weight: 196 g (size M)

name: Storm Cell Tights
short_description: Water-repellent winter tights with a brushed inner face.
description:
A brushed inner face for cold starts and a DWR outer that sheds drizzle and road spray. Same drawcord waist as the Long Haul Tights.

• Brushed-back nylon / elastane
• DWR finish
• Flat drawcord waist
• Reflective print at the ankle
• Weight: 224 g (size M)

name: Cadence Sports Bra
short_description: Medium-support bra with a wide underband and no hardware.
description:
Wide underband, bonded edges and no clasps anywhere, so nothing digs in under a race vest on a long descent.

• Recycled nylon / elastane
• Medium support, no hardware
• Wide underband, bonded edges
• Removable pads
• Weight: 92 g (size M)

name: Trail Support Bra
short_description: High-support bra with adjustable straps for long days out.
description:
Higher coverage and adjustable straps for runners who want more support, with the same bonded, hardware-free build as the Cadence.

• Recycled nylon / elastane
• High support
• Adjustable straps
• Bonded edges, no hardware
• Weight: 104 g (size M)

name: First Light Vest
short_description: A packable insulated gilet for cold starts and fast descents.
description:
Recycled synthetic fill that keeps working when damp, in a gilet cut that leaves your arms free to move.

• Recycled synthetic fill, 60 gsm
• Packable into its own pocket
• Two zipped hand pockets
• Elasticated armholes
• Weight: 218 g (size M)

name: Dawn Layer Vest
short_description: A lighter insulated gilet in clay, for shoulder-season runs.
description:
Half the fill of the First Light Vest, so it packs smaller and still cuts the wind on an early start.

• Recycled synthetic fill, 40 gsm
• Packable into its own pocket
• Wind-resistant face fabric
• Weight: 176 g (size M)

name: Summit Race Vest 12L
short_description: A 12-litre race vest for unsupported days and long mountain races.
description:
Two front bottle pockets, a roll-top main compartment and enough rear volume for a full day out. Bounce-free when the straps are set right.

• 12 L total volume
• Two 500 ml front flask pockets
• Roll-top main compartment
• Pole carry on the rear
• Weight: 245 g

name: Summit Race Vest 5L
short_description: The 5-litre race vest for shorter races and fast training days.
description:
The Summit vest with the volume stripped back to 5 litres, for races with aid stations and days when you carry only the essentials.

• 5 L total volume
• Two 500 ml front flask pockets
• Zipped rear pocket
• Weight: 186 g

name: Wander Pack 28L
short_description: A 28-litre pack for long day routes and fast overnighters.
description:
A ventilated back panel, side compression that cinches down when the load is small, and a lid pocket for the things you want without stopping.

• 28 L total volume
• Ventilated back panel
• Dual side compression
• Hydration sleeve, 3 L
• Weight: 780 g

name: Wander Pack 20L
short_description: A 20-litre version of the Wander Pack for shorter days.
description:
Same back panel and compression as the 28 L, in a smaller shell that sits high and stays put when you run the descents.

• 20 L total volume
• Ventilated back panel
• Dual side compression
• Hydration sleeve, 2 L
• Weight: 640 g

name: Soft Flask 500 ml
short_description: A 500 ml soft flask that shrinks as you drink.
description:
Collapses to nothing as it empties, so it stops sloshing on the second half of a run. Fits the Summit vest front pockets.

• 500 ml capacity
• Collapses as it empties
• Wide 42 mm bite valve
• BPA-free TPU
• Weight: 46 g

name: Soft Flask 250 ml
short_description: The 250 ml soft flask for short races and top-ups.
description:
Half the volume of the 500 ml flask, for races with aid stations or for carrying electrolytes alongside plain water.

• 250 ml capacity
• Collapses as it empties
• Wide 42 mm bite valve
• BPA-free TPU
• Weight: 32 g

name: Carbon Poles (pair)
short_description: Three-section carbon poles that fold down to 38 cm.
description:
Z-fold carbon shafts that stow on the race vest when the terrain runs, with cork grips that stay grippy when wet.

• Carbon Z-fold, three sections
• Folded length: 38 cm
• Cork grip, extended foam lower
• Weight: 198 g per pole

name: Alpine Poles (pair)
short_description: Aluminium poles for rocky ground and heavier loads.
description:
Aluminium shafts take more abuse than carbon on rock, with the same cork grips and Z-fold pack size.

• Aluminium Z-fold, three sections
• Folded length: 40 cm
• Cork grip, extended foam lower
• Weight: 246 g per pole

name: Base Camp Organizer Cubes
short_description: A three-piece packing cube set for race weekends and travel.
description:
Three sizes that nest inside each other when empty, with a mesh face so you can see what is where without unpacking.

• Set of three: 12 L, 8 L, 4 L
• Nest inside each other when empty
• Mesh face panels
• Water-resistant ripstop
• Weight: 186 g (set)

name: Trail Organizer Cubes (2 pack)
short_description: Two smaller cubes sized for shoes and wet kit.
description:
A two-piece set in sand, sized for a pair of shoes and a wet layer, with a wipe-clean lining.

• Set of two: 6 L, 3 L
• Wipe-clean lining
• Water-resistant ripstop
• Weight: 112 g (set)

name: Dawn Chorus Cap
short_description: A soft, packable cap with a foldable brim.
description:
Folds into a pocket without creasing, with a soft brim you can bend to the light and a sweatband that actually absorbs.

• Recycled polyester, 100 gsm
• Foldable soft brim
• Moisture-wicking sweatband
• Adjustable rear strap
• Weight: 62 g

name: Dawn Chorus Beanie
short_description: A merino beanie for cold starts and post-run warmth.
description:
Fine-gauge merino that fits under a hood and does not itch, with a folded band you can pull down over your ears.

• 100% merino wool, fine gauge
• Folded double-layer band
• Fits under a hood
• Weight: 68 g

name: Horizon Glasses
short_description: Lightweight sunglasses with a smoke lens and grippy temples.
description:
A single-piece lens for a wide field of view and hydrophilic temples that hold on when you sweat.

• Single-piece smoke lens, cat. 3
• UV400 protection
• Hydrophilic nose and temples
• Weight: 26 g

name: Horizon Photochromic
short_description: Horizon Glasses with a photochromic lens for dawn-to-dusk runs.
description:
The lens darkens in sun and clears in shade or under trees, so one pair covers a run that starts before light and ends in the open.

• Photochromic lens, cat. 1-3
• UV400 protection
• Hydrophilic nose and temples
• Weight: 28 g

name: Merino Trail Socks (2 pack)
short_description: Two pairs of merino cushioned trail socks.
description:
A cushioned heel and toe with a merino blend that manages sweat, in a two-pack so one pair is always dry.

• Merino blend, 200-needle
• Cushioned heel and toe
• Seamless toe
• Pack of two pairs
• Weight: 68 g per pair

name: Cushion Crew Socks
short_description: Crew-height socks with a dense cushion for long days.
description:
Higher than the trail crew and denser underfoot, for runners who want more padding on hard ground.

• Cotton / nylon blend, dense cushion
• Crew height
• Seamless toe
• Pack of two pairs
• Weight: 82 g per pair

name: Ridgeline Gloves
short_description: Lightweight gloves with touchscreen fingertips.
description:
Wind-resistant back and a grippy palm, thin enough to wear while you fiddle with a flask or a phone.

• Wind-resistant softshell back
• Silicone palm print
• Touchscreen index and thumb
• Weight: 52 g per pair

name: Nightfall Run Gloves
short_description: Warmer gloves with a reflective print for night runs.
description:
A brushed inner face for cold mornings and a reflective print across the back of the hand so drivers see your hands move.

• Brushed-back softshell
• Reflective print on the back
• Touchscreen index and thumb
• Weight: 64 g per pair

name: Garmin Forerunner 165
short_description: A GPS running watch with a bright AMOLED display and multi-band positioning.
description:
Multi-band GPS for accurate tracks under tree cover, an AMOLED screen that stays readable in sun, and training metrics that load onto the watch.

• 1.2 in AMOLED display
• Multi-band GNSS
• Wrist-based heart rate
• Up to 11 days battery in smartwatch mode
• Note: third-party brand — confirm resale authorisation before selling

name: Dawn Split GPS Watch
short_description: A lightweight GPS watch built for trail days.
description:
Big buttons you can hit with gloves, a barometric altimeter for climb totals, and a battery that lasts a long race.

• 1.1 in transflective display
• Barometric altimeter
• Wrist-based heart rate
• Up to 24 hours in GPS mode
• Weight: 42 g

name: Polar H10 Heart Rate Strap
short_description: A chest strap heart rate sensor with a soft textile band.
description:
Chest straps read heart rate more reliably than a wrist sensor when you are moving, and this one pairs over Bluetooth and ANT+.

• Bluetooth and ANT+
• Soft textile band, machine washable
• User-replaceable battery
• Note: third-party brand — confirm resale authorisation

name: Cadence HR Belt
short_description: Our own chest strap sensor, for pairing with any watch.
description:
The same reliable chest-strap readings as the Polar, in a lighter band with a slimmer pod.

• Bluetooth and ANT+
• Lightweight band, 38 g
• User-replaceable battery
• Water resistant to 3 ATM

name: Night Runner 800
short_description: An 800-lumen headlamp with a wide beam for running.
description:
A wide, even beam so you see the trail edges, not just a bright spot, with a rear red light for road sections.

• 800 lumens max
• Wide running beam pattern
• Rear red safety light
• USB-C rechargeable, 40 h low
• Weight: 118 g with battery

name: Petzl Actik Core Headlamp
short_description: A rechargeable 600-lumen headlamp with a hybrid power option.
description:
Runs on the supplied rechargeable core battery or three AAA cells, so you are never stuck without light on a trip.

• 600 lumens max
• Rechargeable core battery, or 3 x AAA
• Red night-vision mode
• Weight: 75 g with core battery
• Note: third-party brand — confirm resale authorisation before selling

name: Dawn Trail Headlamp
short_description: A 500-lumen headlamp for dawn starts and camp.
description:
Lighter than the Night Runner with a narrower beam, for early starts where you mostly need to see the next few metres.

• 500 lumens max
• Spot and flood modes
• USB-C rechargeable, 60 h low
• Weight: 86 g with battery

name: Nathan Hypernight Reflective Vest
short_description: A reflective vest for road running before light.
description:
Retroreflective panels front and back that light up in headlights, over a mesh body that does not add heat.

• Retroreflective panels, front and back
• Breathable mesh body
• Adjustable side straps
• Weight: 96 g
• Note: third-party brand — confirm resale authorisation before selling

name: Dusk Reflective Vest
short_description: Our own reflective vest with a 360-degree stripe.
description:
A continuous reflective stripe around the body so you are visible from the side as well as from behind.

• 360-degree reflective stripe
• Breathable mesh body
• Adjustable side straps
• Weight: 88 g

name: Trail Fuel Box (12 pack)
short_description: Twelve gels in a mixed box, for a full race or a big training block.
description:
A mix of caffeinated and plain gels so you can plan intake across a race, in a box that lives in your kit bag.

• 12 gels, mixed flavours
• 6 caffeinated, 6 plain
• ~22 g carbohydrate per gel
• Best before: see individual sachets

name: GU Original Energy Gel (box of 13)
short_description: A box of 13 energy gel sachets.
description:
The classic gel format: a measured 100-calorie dose you can take without stopping, with a consistency that goes down easily at effort.

• 13 sachets per box
• ~100 kcal per sachet
• Electrolyte blend
• Note: third-party brand — confirm resale authorisation

name: Nuun Sport Electrolytes (10 tablets)
short_description: A tube of 10 electrolyte tablets that dissolve in your flask.
description:
Drop one in 500 ml and it dissolves without fizzing over, replacing what you lose in sweat on a hot day.

• 10 tablets per tube
• Makes 5 L of drink
• Low sugar
• Note: third-party brand — confirm resale authorisation

name: Trail Salt Tablets
short_description: Our own electrolyte tablets, sized for a long day out.
description:
A higher-sodium tablet for runners who cramp on long efforts, in a tube that fits a vest pocket.

• 20 tablets per tube
• Makes 10 L of drink
• Higher sodium for long efforts
• Caffeine-free

name: Downhill Recovery Roller
short_description: A hollow-core foam roller for post-run legs.
description:
A firm hollow core that holds its shape, with a textured surface that gets into the quads after a long descent.

• Length: 33 cm
• Hollow EVA core, firm density
• Textured surface
• Weight: 420 g

name: TriggerPoint MB1 Massage Ball
short_description: A firm massage ball for feet, glutes and shoulders.
description:
Small enough to work into the arch of a foot or under a shoulder blade, and firm enough to actually release the tissue.

• Diameter: 12.7 cm
• Firm density
• Weight: 340 g
• Note: third-party brand — confirm resale authorisation
